ops.parking: The car park on B1F-B3F has 415 spaces. The height limit is 2.1 m on the main entrance side and 2.6 m on the Central Park side. Motorcycles (motorbikes and scooters) cannot be parked. The fee is 400 yen per 30 minutes, and guests using the banquet facilities park free for up to 3 hours 30 minutes. A wheelchair-accessible parking space is on B3F.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has Crossroads Kitchen, Nineteen Eighty Lounge & Bar, Jade Garden (翡翠宮), Eau de Vie and Shinjuku Nadaman (official website, restaurants & bars page).
